hints.title: Complete Binary Tree Geometry
hints.text: In this complete binary tree, the parent of node x is simply floor(x / 2).

hints.title: Tree Path and Added Edge Cycle
hints.text: Adding an edge between a and b creates a unique cycle consisting of the tree path between a and b plus the new edge.

hints.title: Ascending to Lowest Common Ancestor
hints.text: Repeatedly divide the larger node value by 2 until both nodes converge at their common ancestor, counting total step hops.

hints.title: Binary Tree LCA Cycle Queries Implementation

complexity.notes: Each query takes at most 2 * n divisions to reach common ancestor.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Building an explicit adjacency graph with 2^n nodes takes exponential memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses heap arithmetic parent = node // 2 to find distance to LCA in logarithmic steps.
